maps.derivation: corpus-map.json is merge(package map, overlay) under rules-factory decision 0015. The package is referenced at an exact version in Directory.Packages.props and pinned by content hash in src/HoyleBackgammon/packages.lock.json, restored in locked mode; the overlay sets only status, implementedIn and tests, the build facts only this engine can know. scripts/validate.sh fails if the overlay sets any other field or names an entry the package lacks, if corpus-map.json is not exactly the merge, or if this upstream is not the restored package. Corrections this build finds go upstream (MAP-FINDINGS.md) and arrive as a new package version, never applied here.
